detail.longDescription: Grants for short term scientific missions (STSMs, 1-6 weeks of duration) are available to visit and work on research projects within the Center of Gravity (CoG). The CoG a DNRF Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute and at the Astrophysical and Cosmological Relativity Department at @ mpi_grav Potsdam, a partner of the CoG. We are inviting you to submit proposals for STMSs starting after April 2027 and ending before 1 October 2027. We are looking for exciting and challenging research proposals to be developed jointly with our members. We value high risk/high gain proposals at the boundary between different research directions within CoG. ℹ️  https://www. aei.mpg.de/1514273/the-center- of-gravity-exchange-of-researchers-working-on-gravitational-physics 📅 This call starts on 1 October and closes 30 November 2026. All proposals will be reviewed and the results will be announced by 1 January 2027. # Academia # FediHire # Physics # Research # ResearchExchange # Potsdam # Copenhagen
